normal_flow: The method allocates a 16-byte stack frame and initializes a local bool to false.
Reads this+0x30, identified by generated Cpp2IL as _isInsideSlide. If zero, returns without calling the save helper.
If nonzero, calls SaveItemInBulkData(this, &localBool); the caller does not read the local bool afterward.

SaveItemInBulkData initializes its out bool false. When _includeRoot is true, it obtains the active scene root GameObjects and iterates them; two calls to unresolved target 0x25751c8 must both report success before SetInSildeData is called for the second result.
SaveItemInBulkData then iterates _dropAreas (when non-null/nonempty), obtains each single item, filters Unity null/equality, and calls SetInSildeData for accepted results.

SetInSildeData statically branches on runtime type for LevelCharacter/LevelToddler free-hands calls, sets its out bool true, detaches the item transform with worldPositionStays=true, forms a persistence key using prefix Slide_ and _currentLevelType, adds prefab data through SeparatedPDManager.AddToBulkData, then calls LevelUtils.DestroyLevelItem(item, true). These are static call/argument observations; full callee semantics are not recovered.
The helper body contains a noncontiguous branch trampoline at 0x3f932d0 that loads a second type-info slot and rejoins at 0x1f05010; its type identity is unresolved.
